_about: Budgets and rules per target, read by `pw.py check`. Numbers come from the research notes of 2026-10-11 (ai-docs/research); severity fail blocks delivery, warn is reported. Change a number only with a source: log it in the owning skill's RESEARCH.md and CHANGELOG.md.

game-roblox.about: Roblox MeshPart through the 3D Importer (FBX, OBJ or glTF)
advice: 20,000 triangles per mesh (create.roblox.com specifications, checked 2026-10-11; vendors quote 21,000, test the importer). Split bigger models into several MeshParts.
One material per mesh; SurfaceAppearance takes colour, normal (OpenGL, Y+), roughness, metalness. Texture size limit unverified (historically 1024 px).
1 stud = 0.28 m: a 1.8 m person is about 6.4 studs. Export in metres and scale in Studio, or scale by 1/0.28 before export.
At most 4 bone influences per vertex, root joint at the origin, no zero-thickness surfaces. CollisionFidelity Box or Hull for props.

game-unity.about: Unity prop or character (GLB through glTFast or FBX)
advice: Y-up, metres. FBX: scale 1 with Apply Scalings 'FBX All' and bake the axis change (`convert --fbx-bake-axes`) so the root is not rotated -90 on X; GLB needs nothing.
Normal maps OpenGL (Y+). URP/HDRP mask maps pack differently from glTF ORM.
LODs: name children <name>_LOD0, _LOD1 ... (`pw.py lods`). Collision: a simple box, capsule or convex hull, never the render mesh for moving objects.
The prop budget is a project choice: 50k is a generous hero-prop ceiling for desktop; mobile props are often 1k to 10k.

game-unreal.about: Unreal Engine 5 static mesh (FBX, glTF or USD)
advice: Unreal is Z-up and centimetres; the importer converts from metres. Check scale on import.
Nanite (UE 5.8 docs) takes dense opaque and masked static and skeletal meshes, no manual LODs. Not for translucent materials or morph targets: those still need a budget and LODs.
Normal maps DirectX (Y-): flip the green channel or tick Flip Green Channel. Collision pieces prefixed UCX_.
GLB with meshopt or Draco geometry and KTX2 textures: `gltf-transform optimize in.glb out.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress ktx2`, then gltf_validator.
1 unit = 1 m, +Y up, front faces +Z (glTF spec). Origin at the bottom centre for product models.
The 10 MB and 150k triangle figures are a page-weight choice, not a spec; the threewright plugin checks the page itself.
Blender `wm.usd_export` to .usdz with a preview surface and downscaled textures; check with `usdchecker --arkit`.
About 100k polygons and one set of 2048 px textures is Apple's long-standing guidance (secondary source, 2021); real size, origin on the floor.

commerce-gltf.about: Product model for e-commerce viewers (Khronos 3D Commerce guidelines)
advice: Real size, 1 unit = 1 m, origin at the bottom centre, triangles only, metalness 0 or 1 (Khronos 3D Commerce, checked 2026-10-11).
The current guideline text gives no numeric triangle or size presets; 5 MB is the commonly quoted v1.0 figure (secondary).

print-fdm.about: FDM print, 0.4 mm nozzle, 256 mm cube bed (Bambu P1S, X1, A1 class)
advice: Walls at least 2 perimeters (about 0.9 mm), better 1.2 to 1.6 mm. Details under 0.5 mm vanish.
Overhangs past about 45 degrees need support; chamfer rather than fillet bed-facing edges; 0.3 mm clearance for parts that move or slot together (Prusa guide).
Too big for the bed: split with pins (3 mm, 0.2 mm clearance) or the slicer's Cut tool.
Hand the slicer a 3MF when a printer-specific skill or the slicer CLI is available; the STL stays the verified artefact.

print-resin.about: Resin (MSLA) print: miniatures and fine detail
advice: Bed size varies by printer: the default is a mid-size 9 to 10 inch class; pass the real one in the brief.
Hollow large solids (2 to 3 mm walls) and add drain holes; tilt and support in the slicer.

video-blockout.about: Blockout or proxy for AI video and previs (structure guides, depth and normal passes)
advice: Real scale matters more than detail: the camera, the depth pass and the character height must agree.
Render turntables and the camera path with `pw.py render` or a bpy script with Z/Mist and Normal passes; hand them to the video plugin as conditioning.

cad-step.about: Engineering interchange (STEP from code CAD), with a mesh preview
advice: A mesh cannot become a true STEP; model in build123d, CadQuery, OpenSCAD or FreeCAD and export STEP from the B-rep, plus STL or GLB for previews.
Check the preview mesh here; check the STEP by reopening it and comparing volume.
